thread:
David (CEO): quick Q&A follow from today's all-hands  focusing on why we won or lost key deals. please keep replies short.
Emma (Head of Product): top win themes: predictable performance, clear onboarding, and responsive CS during pilot. top loss themes: inability to meet VPC/HSM needs, latency spikes under peak, and unexpected model quality regressions.
Raj (Sales): real example: NovaBank lost us because we couldn't provide a contractually backed latency SLA and they needed p95 < 250ms.
Sophia (CS): FinOpt required on-prem key control; legal/policy blocked quick delivery. they moved to a vendor with an HSM appliance.
Ben (Customer Success): customers keep asking for: 1) 1-week private/VPC quickstart, 2) a simple SLA matrix we can share, 3) a reproducible eval kit for regressions.
Lin (Eng PM): proposed minimal work for VPC quickstart: terraform module + onboarding checklist + runbook. estimate: 4 sprint-weeks with 2 engineers.
David (CEO): leadership ask: can product + eng produce a one-page commitment list by next Tues (scope, risks, owners)?
Emma (Head of Product): yes — i'll coordinate. Ben/Raj/Lin  please draft the "why-we-lost" playbook mapping reasons to mitigations.
allhands-bot: :spiral_calendar: task created: "why-we-lost playbook" owner: Ben, due: 14 days.
Raj (Sales): quick Q: any appetite for a paid "latency premium" tier? customers would pay for guaranteed p95.
David (CEO): explore pricing. finance to model costs; product to draft offer.
Emma (Head of Product): thanks all; i'll post the follow-up notes and owners in the channel and convert to tickets after the leadership review.
